authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/modal/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/modal/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI CC implementation chart, with its printed name, sent as a control change on the channel variable. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The chart prints controller numbers only: every value is 0 - 127, and a setting chosen from a list is a number here, not a choice.

Left out, the wheel, the pedals, the joystick, bank select, the NRPN controllers and the channel mode messages: CC 0 Bank Change, CC 1 Mod Wheel, CC 11 Expression Pedal, CC 64 Sustain Pedal, CC 116 Joystick X+, CC 117 Joystick X-, CC 118 Joystick Y-, CC 120 All Sound Off, CC 121 Reset All Controllers, CC 123 All Notes Off, CC 124 Omni Off, CC 125 Omni On.
Numbers the chart marks unused (`-`) or leaves blank: 2, 4, 6, 10, 12, 38, 65, 66, 74, 76, 77, 97, 98, 99, 122, 126, 127.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends these same controllers when its panel is used, where its MIDI settings allow
